defs.def: to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way 发音；读（音）

ex.s: For native speakers of English, some Chinese words are rather difficult to pronounce.
Every time I gave a self-introduction, I had to explain how to pronounce my name at least five times, yet they still could not say it the way I did.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，在家里墙上自由自在、快乐地涂鸦。

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.

defs.def: to say or give sth formally, officially or publicly 正式宣布（或公布、授予等）

ex.s: Words within a complete sentence can be pronounced in two different ways: weak and strong.
ex.t: 完整句子中的词可以用两种不同的方式发音：弱读和强读。

ex.s: But I don’t know how to pronounce it.
ex.t: 但我不知道它怎么发音。

ex.s: Read the words to each other and see if you pronounce them differently.
ex.t: 互相读这些词，看看你的发音是否不同。

ex.s: Notice how the plosives are pronounced.
ex.t: 注意爆破音的发音方式。

ex.s: Some words are pronounced really fast and sound different.
ex.t: 有些词发音非常快，听起来不一样。
